verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Airwallex ships developer tooling that functions as SDK-like building blocks — the Airwallex.js/`@airwallex/components-sdk` client library, a full REST API with docs, an official CLI, and dedicated MCP servers/AgentOS for AI agents — which together let an AI-native developer build integrations. However, there is no dedicated 'SDKs' page listing official language SDKs (Node, Python, Java, etc.) or GitHub SDK repos, only a JS component library and CLI/MCP tooling. missing for 10: explicit multi-language official SDK library list/docs, independent corroboration of SDK quality/adoption.
